title: Quasi-Periodic Dual-Band λ/4 Initialization with Reduced Step-Size
scientific_hypothesis: Initializing layer thicknesses from quarter-wave optical thicknesses at both 360 nm and 1050 nm center wavelengths, rather than uniform or block seeding, establishes a physically coherent phase-matching baseline that reduces early-cycle optimizer overshoot and improves convergence toward the dual-stopband target.
design_principle: Modified Quarter-Wavelength Optimization: Start with λ/4 optical thickness layers for high-reflection bands at both stopband centers, then vary optical thickness through optimization to smooth spectral characteristics and broaden suppression bands.
proposed_topology: Air | (Ta2O5 | SiO2) × 18 | Fused Silica substrate; exactly 36 finite layers with alternating high-low index sequence starting with Ta2O5
theory_basis: Quarter-wave stack theory for high-reflectance bands at multiple center wavelengths
expected_advantages: Better initial phase matching reduces optimizer iterations needed
Reduced step-size prevents early-cycle overshoot into local minima
Dual-band initialization addresses both stopbands simultaneously
known_risks: May still converge to local optimum if step-size too conservative
Quarter-wave initialization may bias toward narrow stopbands
execution_request_english: Optimize a 36-layer Ta2O5/SiO2 multilayer filter on fused silica substrate at 0 deg incidence, unpolarized light. Initialize all 36 layer thicknesses from quarter-wave optical thicknesses computed at 360 nm and 1050 nm center wavelengths in alternating sequence. Use gradient-based optimizer with step-size scaling factor reduced by 50% compared to standard. Layer thickness bounds: 20-350 nm. Materials: Ta2O5 (high index), SiO2 (low index). Optimize all 36 thicknesses to minimize average transmittance in 355-365 nm and 1030-1080 nm bands while maximizing average transmittance in 420-700 nm band. Canonical user controls: incidence angles 0 degrees. polarization unpolarized. wavelength intervals 355-355 nm, 355-365 nm, 420-700 nm, 1030-1080 nm. soft objectives: high average transmittance in 420-700 nm; low average transmittance at 355 nm; low average transmittance in 355-365 nm; low average transmittance in 1030-1080 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: high transmittance at 355 nm; high transmittance in 355-365 nm; high transmittance in 1030-1080 nm; high loss in 420-700 nm. manufacturing constraints: maximum 36 layers; layer thickness range 20-350 nm.
revision_reason: Implements feedback directive to discard uniform/block seedings and initialize with quasi-periodic λ/4 scaffold at target center wavelengths (360 nm and 1050 nm), with 50% reduced step-size scaling to suppress early-cycle overshoot.
